qualification: MBBS, MS (Obstetrics & Gynaecology), Fellowship in Infertility
content:
Profile

Dr. Vanaja Shivakumar, a distinguished and seasoned Obstetrics, Gynecology, and Infertility Specialist, brings a wealth of expertise to her practice. With a particular focus on Infertility and the Management of High-Risk Pregnancies, she stands out for her unique approach to facilitating painless normal deliveries through labor analgesia.

Her journey in the medical field began with earning her MBBS from the prestigious Bangalore Medical College and Research Institute, followed by an impressive 35th rank in PG CGT. Subsequently, she pursued her M.S. in Obstetrics and Gynecology at the renowned Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College. Dr. Vanaja Shivakumar further honed her skills through a fellowship in Infertility under the guidance of Dr. Kamini Rao, the esteemed founder of an infertility institution.

With a remarkable 25 years of dedicated practice, Dr. Vanaja Shivakumar is deeply committed to second-generation maternity care, overseeing more than 40 deliveries each month, including challenging surgical procedures.

Noteworthy is her credit of recognition for a specialized study on adolescent health issues. This expertise equips her to address critical points concerning adolescent health at the right junctures, contributing to comprehensive and timely care for this demographic.

Dr. Vanaja Shivakumar's commitment to excellence, coupled with her extensive experience and specialized focus areas, positions her as a leading authority in the field of women's health and maternity care.

content:
Profile

Meet Dr. Amardeep M.R., a distinguished consultant orthopedic surgeon specializing in arthroscopy and arthroplasty. His journey in the field of orthopedics began with an MBBS degree from the renowned Bangalore Medical College and Research Institute. Dr. Amardeep's commitment to excellence and academic prowess led him to secure a top rank in the postgraduate entrance exam, culminating in the completion of his MS in Orthopedics from the esteemed GMCH, Chandigarh.

The pinnacle of Dr. Amardeep's training unfolded during a three-year senior residency at the All India Institute of Medical Science, New Delhi, from 2020 to 2023. Under the mentorship of eminent professors in the field of arthroplasty and orthoscopy, he honed his skills to become a seasoned orthopedic expert. His expertise further expanded during his tenure at the prestigious AIIMS Jai Prakash Narayan Apex Trauma Centre, New Delhi, where he gained valuable experience in complex trauma surgeries and polytrauma management.

Returning to Karnataka, Dr. Amardeep has been making significant contributions to the field of orthopedics. Currently serving as a consultant at Shivam Advanced Ortho Care in Bangalore, his practice encompasses a wide range of specialties, showcasing his proficiency as a clinician and skilled surgeon. Dr. Amardeep has garnered extensive experience in conducting complex trauma surgeries, including knee and shoulder arthroscopies, ACL reconstruction, ligament surgeries, total knee replacement, and hip replacement surgeries.

His commitment to excellence is evident in the consistently positive outcomes he achieves for his patients. Dr. Amardeep's passion for advancing orthopedic care and his dedication to staying at the forefront of medical advancements make him a trusted name in the field.

She holds a Master’s degree in Biomedical Genetics with specialization in Genetic Counselling and is a Level II Certified Genetic Counselor accredited by the Board of Genetic Counseling India.

She specializes in counselling and supporting clinicians and families through complex genetic conditions, including recurrent pregnancy loss, abnormal screening or genetic test results, complex fetal anomalies, and recurrence risk assessment in families with inherited genetic disorders. Her patient-centered approach helps families make informed decisions with clarity, empathy, and confidence.

She holds a Master’s degree in Food Science and Nutrition and specializes in women’s health nutrition, focusing on fertility, antenatal care, postnatal recovery, lactation support, and pediatric nutrition.

She also provides nutritional management for lifestyle and medical conditions including PCOS, gestational diabetes, thyroid disorders, obesity, and heart disease. Her approach combines evidence-based nutrition planning with compassionate counseling, working closely with multidisciplinary medical teams to create personalized diet plans that support healthier outcomes for women and children.
